value: MIT SEAL Framework (Self-Adapting LLMs): Enables permanent knowledge absorption. Process: 1) LLM generates synthetic 'study sheets' from input (rewrites/summarizes), 2) Quizzes itself on each via reinforcement learning, 3) Applies best-performing self-edit to update weights. Model chooses learning rate, iterations, data synthesis method. Results: +15% QA accuracy, +50% skill learning. Limitation: catastrophic forgetting (mitigated in future work). Application: Hivemind agents can permanently learn instead of just caching.

metadata.authors: Pari, Zweiger, Guo, Akyürek, Kim, Agrawal
